items.note: The plan states the exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with restored scratch and follows the proof at 741-765: the net change (JV+RG)x is independent of a,c, the bit and complex coefficient cancellations, and the three-stage composition. The gate definitions and neighbour rule are only implicit, and the wire and neighbour counts (767-783) are omitted. Neither omission breaks the argument.

It states D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and the route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}, and derives them from the paper's invariant (stored = frame applied to logical) and the commutation of a common frame with a pointwise gate.

All the defining content is stated correctly: the form |S cap T|-1, nondegenerate labels in F^{otimes 3}, only central 3->4 edges decrease (by h), L=Ich, the sum Wm-2N+2L, and the ratios 100/539 and 101/539. The route is right: stage chaining, side-wire inclusion, telescoping and L=Ich. But the time-indexed gate-label table (eq:motif-labels) and the residual table that verify nestedness edge by edge are not rebuilt, so the decreasing-edge claim is quoted rather than shown. The orthonormal-basis argument over F_2 is absent.

It has the matrices P_U and -P_{U_a}, the frames Phi_M, and the endpoint difference P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m. It also has rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, the N source exceptions 2P_{U_a} of rank one, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b with deficit N-2L_b>0, exactly as in 1156-1172.

The phase frames C_U, one translation kernel aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector, s_c=W_cm-2N+2L_c and telescoping to C^{otimes m} are all stated, and the weight-additivity, odd-weight and 27-coordinate Z-correction steps are derived. Missing are the zero label has frame I and the full label has frame C^{otimes m} (since q_F(x)=wt(x)), which is what gives C^{otimes m} on every non-exceptional route, and the k-column tensoring.

It has L<N/2 from the exact ratios, s_b<W_b m and s_c<W_c m, the exact eta_b and eta_c, both greater than 20*2^{-50}, log m<20 and m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-eta), giving s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}. That is the paper's argument at 1319-1346.

The controlled-shift lemma is derived as in 574-621: split and merge at Q-a, b^C=O(Q) absorbing the offset work, c increasing pieces for units, and negation by stack reversal. The elementary-streams lemma is only stated (S0.1.1, quoting 494); its split-by-digit and cyclic row-split proof (513-550) is not shown.

It has the factorisation A=E_1 Pi E_2 by top-row/rightmost-pivot elimination, the choice of prime, linear-cost triangular transforms, the conjugation order, and the three-update implementation of each one of Pi with a single interchange. Hence exactly a interchanges, i.e. a recursive calls.

It follows the proof step by step: the cyclic row split into W role streams of volume V/W, Phi_{A_e} on each edge via the matrix shear, the frame identity with Phi_M and the endpoint condition, and the three-update interchange. Then exactly s calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with the geometric sum, and the fixed-tape depth-first schedule including one-bit payloads.

It has rho=ceil(k log W/(2 log q)) high digits forming a row field R=q^{2 rho}>=W^k, padding to R'<2R, base-m pieces costing O(V) sum a_j m^{j tau}=O(Ve^tau), the piece and descriptor count, binary padding to [q^e], and the unequal-width variant, all as in the paper.

It has conjugation by P_M with the residual basis as the first columns of M, one child (C^{eps_h})^{otimes f} per slot, the inverse-child identity, row additions bounded by m(m-1)+3m, exactly s_c children on f=e/m axes, and H_0^{otimes D}=b^D S_D C^{otimes D} S_D. One notational slip (beta for b) is listed as an error.

It reconstructs the eight packed additions and their parity cycles, the guard interval and delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}}, and T_0 S_0^{-1} permuting the bad set. Then the swap and rotation implementation, the rank-counter extraction with radix sort, the last-position XOR, the full time bound, and its use for one row addition. A loose phrase in S0.1.5.4.3 is listed as an error.

It has the node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)) and rows from the first q_0 chunks, with R_row>=W^{k_0} padded to a multiple of W^{k_0}. It has the split u=Wg+w giving V/W children and F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with F(e)=O(e) below d^beta. The overhead is O(e^lambda) via K<=e^{c/beta}, and the leaf bound and the base-m pieces give O(d^{lambda'}) for max{lambda,sigma+beta(1-sigma)}<lambda'<1 (S0.1.5.6.7). The S0.1.5.6 headline is looser and is listed as an error.

It states the O(Vd^{lambda'}) layer with one truncation and error <sqrt2 2^{-p}. It derives the guard width Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1})=o(p) from A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, A(e)<=8e at leaves, and B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu. It also has the uniform packed-call cost and the disk-preserving truncation, as in 2450-2586 and 2686-2758.

It has character cancellation by the sign-changing shift, decimation in frequency, bit-reversed storage B_t, and the opposite procedure F_t^+B_t^{-1}. It has the layout L from prefix moves and width-K chunk exchanges, the cost terms dK, pK^{tau-1} and l d^{lambda'}, commutation of truncation with J_E, and error <sqrt2 l 2^{-p}.

It has evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, the separation bound |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<B_0/2, two's-complement block formation and centred extraction with carry in {0,1}, the numerators ac-be and ae+bc, the negacyclic wrap, truncation after division by 2^{p+l}, and the O(rp log(rp)) cost.

It has the normalisation identity M F^+((F^-f)(F^-g)/r)=(f*g)/(rM), P(LBu,LBv)=LB P(u,v), the error chain 2delta, then +eta, then 3delta+eta, scaled by M to sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p}, and the cost with the log(rp) term, as in the proof.

The identities P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA and RF_s=2^gamma B_0QF_tA, the error and time bounds, and the axis-exposure cost are stated, and the route is the paper's: N=CTD, the Neumann inverse, the normalisations, the ordered selection C, and linewise tensoring with chunk-swap exposure. However, the retained permutations (P_su)_j=u_{tj} and (P_tv)_k=v_{-sk} are never defined, so the statement leaves its central objects unspecified.

It has the chirp a_j, its t_i-periodicity, the coefficient computation giving QF_t (Q reads frequency -s_ij_i), F^+R_c=R_c^{-1}F^+ giving RF_s^+R=F_s^+, commutation with pointwise products, the convolution rule giving (u*v)/S^2, and the conjugation trick.

It has all the fixed exponents and the size choices (b, p=6b, d, K, T, r, t_i), the comparison constants, alpha, gamma and eta, the prime-interval bound with disjoint intervals, T/2<S<T by Bernoulli, alpha^4 theta_i>p, the n^{o(1)} prime search, and the no-wraparound and capacity bounds.

It has Phi as an algebra isomorphism (the image of x has order S), the triangular coordinates b_i=a_i+mu_i sum_{j<i} a_jP_j, updates in order i=d..1, padded-address bijections preserving zero padding, prefix-controlled cyclic shifts, and the O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)) cost.

It has well-definedness from (zeta y)^r=1, the diagonal isomorphism, the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j, and M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T. The twist errors below 4 h_p appear in S0.4.6.9.4.

It has the computed chirp transform, the source transform with exact counterpart 2^gamma B_0QF_tA=RF_s, the conjugated opposite procedure, digit scaling by 2^{-b-2}, the six steps in order, and why the two scales by S undo different normalisations.

It reproduces the error chain E_ring<5TL, then <6TL and <8TL, E_s=9*2^gamma TL, and E_w<28*2^gamma T^2L, with the disk margins, the final bound 448b2^{-b+gamma}<=448b2^{-3b/4}<1/2, unique rounding, and the carry recurrence with its bound and invariant.

It has V=Tp, the seven rows justified from their lemmas, the margins g_1..g_7 with min 2^{-181}=2 kappa, setup p^{A+C}=o(Tp), exceptional sorting o(V), log powers <=p^kappa, and schoolbook below a cutoff, giving O(n(log n)^{1-kappa}).
S0 only says the bound refutes the n log n optimality conjecture in this model. It does not give the eventual lower-bound formulation or the liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0 negation.

errors.says: Every wire segment can be labelled by a nondegenerate subspace of F^{otimes 3} so that adjacent labels are nested.
errors.paper: Labels are attached to gates (one label common to all incidences of a gate) and to sources and sinks; each edge (wire segment) joins two comparable vertex labels, and its orthogonal residual is the complement of the smaller in the larger.

errors.says: Method: replace the permutation frames of the bit network by phase frames diagonalised by the common Hadamard transform.
errors.paper: The phase interface uses the separate complex scalar network (scalars in Z[i,1/2], neighbours are distinct triples with even intersection, an extra central wire C_*) with binary labels over F_2, not the bit network with new frames.

errors.says: Method uses the one-bit identity H_0=beta S C S coordinatewise.
errors.paper: The identity is H_0=b S C S with b=(1-i)/2; beta denotes the recursion cutoff exponent 1/2 elsewhere.

errors.says: Each coordinate moves by at most four, so with ten guard values on either side no segment leaves its quotient range.
errors.paper: An intermediate point may leave its starting quotient square. The guards ensure each K-bit segment starts in [20,2^K-21], so even displacement eight keeps it in [0,2^K-1] and no carry or borrow crosses segments.

errors.says: The recurrence sums to O(d^{lambda'}) over the base-m pieces for any fixed lambda'<1.
errors.paper: The bound holds for any fixed lambda' with max{lambda, sigma+beta(1-sigma)}<lambda'<1 (S0.1.5.6.7 states this correctly).

chain: The tree reaches O(n(log n)^{1-kappa}) by the paper's route. The fixed network, frames, labels and rank budget give s<Wm and tau=1-2^{-50}, which feed both the interchange and the layer recursions. Those feed the synthetic transforms, convolution and signed packing, then Gaussian resampling, the chirp and R-cancellation, then parameters, CRT, twist, assembly, exact recovery and the cost table. It thins out in a few places. The label tables that verify nestedness edge by edge are not rebuilt, so the decreasing-edge claim is quoted. The complex interface does not show why non-exceptional routes get C^{otimes m} (zero and full label frames). The elementary stream lemma is only stated, and the orthonormal-basis fact over F_2 is assumed.

steps.note: Present: the network on three-element subsets of [100], the exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) in three stages restoring every scratch wire, and its derivation. N=binom(100,3)^3 and the triple-of-triples index set are never written out, and m=h^3 is only implicit in F^{otimes 3}.
It has the common frame per vertex commuting with the pointwise gate, the network implementing D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and each edge applying only D_vD_u^{-1}.

It has nondegenerate subspaces of the m-dimensional F^{otimes 3}, nested labels on every edge, and only central 3->4 edges decreasing, each by h. S0.1.3.3 loosely attaches labels to wire segments rather than gates, but S0.1.4.1.1 places them at vertices.
It has rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested U subset V, and the N source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one where the dimension change is zero.
It has sum |Delta dim|=Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, from telescoping at gates and Ic decreasing edges of loss h, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
It has L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, the deficit N-2L_b>0, and s<Wm for both networks.
It has M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m, with P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m on X_a and 0->I elsewhere, so the shear H<-H+D is applied on every role including scratch rows.
It has A=E_1 Pi E_2, a shear costing exactly a interchanges plus O(V), recursive interchange of each pivot pair, and s recursive calls per node.
It has role streams of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), and s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20, giving F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the whole central-saving chain, C1 to C9, with its defining quantities. It has the bank-exchanging network with restored scratch, the frame identity, nested subspace labels with only central 3->4 losses of h, rank equal to dimension change plus N rank-one source edges, the budget Wm-2N+2L and s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b, L/N=100/539 and 101/539 (below 1/2), the endpoint identity giving H<-H+D, edges as exactly-rank-many recursive interchanges, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The only gap is that N=binom(100,3)^3 and the bank index set are not written out in C1.
